title: What Happens When You Send a Message?
topic: A simplified journey of a message through the internet
style: Cinematic technical editorial. Midnight, mint, electric blue. Macro-to-network scale changes, confident kinetic type, luminous packet choreography.

scenes.title: After send
scenes.description: A luminous send symbol emerges inside a radar-like field. Large type asks what happens after send.

scenes.title: One small tap
scenes.description: A tilted, machined smartphone. A message bubble lifts off its screen.

scenes.title: Words become packets
scenes.description: The bubble becomes a grid of numbered data packets, then disperses into paths.

scenes.title: Find a route
scenes.description: Camera orbits a three-dimensional constellation of network nodes while packets trace a highlighted route.

scenes.title: Across the network
scenes.description: Track a glowing packet through a geometric network tunnel.

scenes.title: Back into words
scenes.description: Data packets converge into a second phone. The original message appears, delivered.

scenes.title: A massive journey
scenes.description: Two points connect, becoming one glowing conversation mark. Closing phrase and an iris collapse.

narration.text: What happens when you send a message?
One tap starts an invisible journey.
Your words become data, carried in packets.
Routers pass them across connected networks.
Signals race through cables, fiber, and radio links.
At the other end, the data becomes your message again.
A tiny message. A massive journey.
